There is a healthy level of angst that accompanies an online purchase of something that you have not seen with your own eyes, or touched with your own hands. We are thankful that we took a leap of faith purchasing the Peak Sauna

The communication during purchasing process and preparing us to receive the sauna was A+.

The shipping, packing and crating was exceptional. I was in the shipping and crating business for 40 years. I know that, if peak put this much attention and detail into the crate and packing materials, that the product inside would be well designed and of high quality workmanship.

I am 76 years old and my wife is 73. We were ble to assemble the sauna employing a minimal amount of extra help in just laying crate down on its back for unpacking. Instructions easy to follow and the components fit precisely.

The sauna experience has been everything that we hoped it would be. Much faster recovery from exercise. Joint pain reduced. Chronic inflammation is reducing. I was actually able to make a fist with my right hand this morning. I have three trigger fingers on that hand. I have not been able to make a fist with that hand for months without a lot of discomfort.

Thank you , Peak Sauna, for over exceeding every aspect of our expectations

We love our Shasta sauna

Peak Kilimanjaro 5-Person Outdoor Full Spectrum Infrared Sauna
Brian W.
Wonderful addition to our home and routine

Overall, we’ve been very impressed with the Peak Sauna Kilimanjaro. The quality of the unit really stands out, and the combination of the sauna experience with the red light features is a great addition. The unit is also very easy to use once it’s set up, and the overall design feels thoughtful and well-built.

Pros:
- Excellent build quality: The unit feels solid, well-made, and built to last.

- Red light features: A great addition that sets it apart from many other sauna options and adds another dimension to the experience.

- Ease of use: Once assembled, the sauna is straightforward and intuitive to operate.

Cons / Things to Know Before Ordering:
- Shipping time: Our unit was a pre-order and shipping delays pushed the delivery back a few months from the original estimated timeline. So, if you’re ordering a pre-order unit, I’d recommend setting expectations accordingly and being prepared for the possibility of delays.

- Delivery and handling: The crate arrives in a vertical position and is quite heavy. You’ll definitely want to plan ahead and have enough people available to safely lay the unit flat and get it into position. This is something to consider before delivery day.

- Assembly instructions: The assembly manual could use more detail. The sauna itself has an intuitive design and the build is relatively straightforward, but the installation instructions could do a better job of clearly walking you through each step. More detailed visuals and step-by-step guidance would make the process much easier.

Overall, we’ve had the unit for about a month now, and we’ve really loved adding it to our routine. It’s become something we genuinely look forward to using, and we’ve been very happy with the Kilimanjaro and the experience it’s added to our home.

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review, Brian! We’re thrilled to hear how much you’re enjoying your Kilimanjaro and that the build quality, red light features, and overall experience have lived up to your expectations.

We also really appreciate your honest feedback around shipping, delivery, and assembly. We know waiting longer than expected for a pre-order is frustrating, and we’re continually working to improve both our delivery process and the information we provide customers ahead of delivery. We’re also in the process of updating our assembly manuals with more detailed visuals and step-by-step guidance based on feedback like yours.

Most importantly, we’re so happy to hear the Kilimanjaro has become something you genuinely look forward to using. Thank you again for choosing Peak and for being part of the Peak community!

Love my new Peak Sauna - Shasta

I have had my new sauna for almost 3 weeks now, using it most days (and sometimes twice a day - once to help wake up at a higher heat, shorter time, at night with a lower temp and longer time). It has been amazing. I’ve been using a sauna at a med spa for a year now but only had the chance to get there twice per week previously. I almost bought the same sauna brand they use but I am so glad I didn’t. My Peak Sauna gets so much hotter than theirs and I can feel it easily. It doesn’t take up a lot of room and heats up relatively quickly, and gets hot (much hotter than the stated temperatures). It was easy to put together but the instructions were incorrect and not complete in a couple of areas (I had to call and speak with someone but that was super easy). Other than that, my husband and I put it together in about two hours, even with having to call to figure it out. The longest part was unboxing everything. Very happy with my purchase. It took months of research to finally make a decision and I am very happy with it.

Hi Patricia, we're thrilled to hear how much you're enjoying your Shasta sauna! It’s wonderful that it’s exceeding your expectations and fitting well into your routine. Thanks for sharing your experience and for choosing Peak Saunas!

Peak Saunas
John B.

In February 2026, I placed an order for a Patagonia Sauna and paid the required 50% deposit. Despite multiple assurances regarding the delivery timeframe, the sauna had still not arrived by mid-August, representing a delay of over six months. When the Peak people said it had finally arrived from China or wherever, I did not believe them until they supplied a picture of the crate in some warehouse. They then stated they would not release it without the second half of the purchase price being paid immediately.  I paid the second half, and it never arrived.   In disgust, I reached out and was told that it had defintely shipped, and that I should  "contact local trucking companies myself to locate the shipment", I cancelled the order due to these persistent delays and unfulfilled commitments.

At the time of cancellation, I was promised a full refund of my deposit. However, I discovered today that $450.00 was withheld from the returned amount. Given that the order was cancelled due to the company's inability to deliver the product within the agreed timeframe, withholding these funds was another frustration.

Do not buy from these people!
